description: Ranked passage search over this tenant's document store. Lexical (BM25) by default, or hybrid (reciprocal rank fusion of lexical and embeddings) once a provider is configured via host.docs.index_config -- falls back to lexical (index.mode: "lexical-fallback") if the provider call fails. mode overrides the default: "lexical" (never calls the provider), "embeddings", or "hybrid" (both require a configured provider). Returns [{document_id, name, version, chunk_no, offset, text, score, ranks: {lexical, embeddings}}] -- ranks names each hit's 1-based position in whichever source list(s) found it -- plus an index block naming the mode and how stale the index is.

filter.description: Restrict results to documents matching prefix and/or name.

name.description: Only match this exact document name.

prefix.description: Only match documents whose name starts with this prefix.

mode.description: "auto" (default), "lexical", "embeddings", or "hybrid". "embeddings"/"hybrid" without a configured provider is a validation error.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Optional on the connection that ran signup (or host.redeem): that connection is already bound to the tenant it created, so later calls on it need no tenant_key. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header and never ran signup -- when both a header and this argument are present, the header wins. Omitting it on such a connection returns tenant_key_missing (-32602).

name: host.docs.search
